name: Telangana
description: Telangana, a historic region in Deccan plateau, is known for its majestic Charminar, Kakatiya stone arches, rich royal culture, and dynamic technology hubs.

cuisine.name: Hyderabadi Biryani
cuisine.desc: Savory basmati rice layered with slow-cooked spiced meat and saffron.

cuisine.name: Haleem
cuisine.desc: Rich, slow-cooked paste made of wheat, barley, meat, and lentils crushed with ghee.

streetFood.name: Irani Chai & Osmania Biscuits
streetFood.desc: Rich, creamy tea served with sweet-salty Osmania bakery biscuits.

streetFood.name: Double Ka Meetha
streetFood.desc: Bread pudding dessert soaked in hot saffron-infused milk and cardamom.

desserts.name: Qubani Ka Meetha
desserts.desc: Sweet compote made from dried apricots, typically served with ice cream.

desserts.name: Sheer Khurma
desserts.desc: Festive vermicelli pudding cooked with milk, dates, and chopped nuts.

festivals.name: Bonalu
festivals.desc: Vibrant thanksgiving festival dedicated to Goddess Mahakali with decorated pots.

festivals.name: Bathukamma
festivals.desc: Flower festival celebrated by women structuring beautiful concentric seasonal floral stacks.

hiddenGems.name: Bhongir Fort
hiddenGems.desc: Enormous monolithic rock hill fort offering trekking routes.

hiddenGems.name: Kondagattu
hiddenGems.desc: Scenic hill temple surrounded by thick forest reserve ranges.

topDestinations.name: Golconda Fort
topDestinations.desc: Historic fortress complex famous for acoustic sound properties and royal palaces.

topDestinations.name: Ramappa Temple
topDestinations.desc: UNESCO World Heritage site known for floating brick designs and detailed black basalt stone carvings.

travelTips: Always plan to reach Golconda Fort by 4 PM to secure light and sound show slots
Autos operate heavily in Hyderabad; settle on fare before boarding if not using apps

Winter.weatherDesc: Cool crisp breeze across Hyderabad plateau, pleasant sun, perfect for Golconda climbs and heritage walks.

food.name: Nihari with Roti
food.desc: Slow-cooked meat stew served with traditional local flatbread.

locations.name: Golconda Fort
locations.highlight: Fascinating history and pleasant sunset terrace view.

travelTips: Enjoy open-air sound shows without worrying about the heat

Spring.weatherDesc: Warm pleasant spring days, sweet night breezes, perfect for evening craft shopping at Shilparamam.

food.name: Lassi
food.desc: Sweet cooling yogurt beverage topped with thick cream.

locations.name: Qutb Shahi Tombs
locations.highlight: Historic tombs nestled in landscaped garden borders.

travelTips: Plan museum visits during early afternoons to escape the sun

Summer.weatherDesc: Scorching dry heat, heavy sun waves. Best to explore air-conditioned indoor sights like Salar Jung Museum.

food.name: Qubani Ka Meetha
food.desc: Apricot sweet served chilled with ice cream.

locations.name: Chowmahalla Palace
locations.highlight: Stunning cool marble corridors and vintage chandeliers.

travelTips: Carry water bottles and check out local sweet cooling drinks

Monsoon.weatherDesc: Frequent moderate rain showers, cooling down the plateau. The lakes and surrounding forest ranges become vibrant green.

food.name: Mirchi Bajji & Irani Chai
food.desc: Spicy green chili fritters served alongside hot milk tea.

locations.name: Ananthagiri Hills
locations.highlight: Scenic monsoon mist drives through dense forests.

travelTips: Expect traffic delays in city center roads during heavy showers

weatherWarnings: Dry intense heat waves in May

accessibility.comments: Main monuments like Golconda Fort have step restrictions, but modern hubs (like museums and airports) are fully ramped.
